page.description: XigmaNAS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A FreeBSD-based network-attached-storage system, derived from FreeNAS: web administration, ZFS, SMB/NFS/AFP shares and plugins, installed from a live image.
pros: Web interface for disks, shares, users and services.
ZFS with snapshots and scrubs from the admin UI.
Runs on modest x86_64 hardware, with a small live image.
Long-standing FreeBSD base with a clear upgrade path.
cons: A storage appliance, not a desktop system.
The publisher lists MD5 only, so the SHA-256 values here were computed by ROMinit.
Plugins and some features are community-maintained.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for XigmaNAS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the live ISO to a USB stick with dd or any image writer, or the embedded image to a USB stick or SD card; writing erases the device. Installation then configures the target boot device.

editions.name: Live CD (x64)
editions.description: The full live system with the installer, run from a CD or USB stick.
editions.usbNote: 685 MB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Embedded image (x64)
editions.description: A prebuilt image for USB sticks and small SSDs, without the live CD environment.
editions.usbNote: 282 MB compressed image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.
